inputs.original_text: Tens of thousands marched through central London on Saturday in this so-called biggest protest against the far-right, coming six months after one of Britain's largest far-right turnouts and just weeks before key local elections. It was put together by hundreds of groups like trade unions, anti-racism outfits, and Muslim representative bodies all under the Together Alliance banner. This is textbook elite coordination to whip up a fake crisis, slap the "extreme" label on any genuine resistance, and rig the elections by keeping people split and distracted from who's really pulling the strings behind it all.
